scene.ko: 체크카드를 잃어버려 정지하다가 모르는 결제를 발견해 이의 신청을 하고, 새 카드를 기다리는 동안 한국으로 급히 송금하는 방법을 찾는다.

lines.en: Hi. I think I lost my debit card yesterday. I need to cancel it right away.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 어제 체크카드를 잃어버린 것 같아요. 바로 정지해야 해요.
alt: Hi. I lost my debit card yesterday. Can you cancel it now?
Hello. My debit card is missing, and I need to block it right away.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. I've blocked the card for you. Before I order a new one, could you look over your recent transactions?
lines.ko: 그러셨군요. 카드는 지금 정지해 드렸습니다. 새 카드를 주문하기 전에 최근 거래 내역을 한번 봐 주시겠어요?

lines.en: Sure... Wait, I don't recognize this charge. It's from an online store this morning, for $89.99.
lines.ko: 네... 잠깐만요, 이건 모르는 결제예요. 오늘 아침에 온라인 상점에서 89달러 99센트가 결제됐네요.
alt: Okay... Hold on, I didn't make this payment. It's $89.99 from an online store.
Sure. Hmm, this $89.99 charge from this morning isn't mine.

lines.en: It looks like someone may have used your card. I'll file a dispute for you, and the money should be back in your account within ten days.
lines.ko: 누군가 카드를 쓴 것 같네요. 제가 이의 신청을 해 드릴게요. 열흘 안에 계좌로 돈이 돌아올 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you, I'd appreciate that. How long will it take to get a new card?
lines.ko: 감사합니다, 그렇게 해 주세요. 새 카드는 받는 데 얼마나 걸려요?
alt: Thanks, please do. When will my new card arrive?
Yes, please. And how long until I get a new card?

lines.en: It usually takes five to seven business days.
That's a problem. I need to send money to my mother in Korea today. Is there any other way to do that?
lines.ko: 그럼 곤란한데요. 오늘 한국에 계신 어머니께 돈을 보내 드려야 하거든요. 다른 방법이 있을까요?
alt: Oh, that's a problem. I have to send money to my mom in Korea today. Can I do it another way?
Hmm, I need to send some money to Korea today. Is there any other way?

lines.en: Yes, I can send an international wire transfer for you right here. The fee is $35, and I'll need her bank's SWIFT code and account number.
lines.ko: 네, 여기서 바로 해외 송금을 해 드릴 수 있어요. 수수료는 35달러이고, 어머님 은행의 SWIFT 코드와 계좌 번호가 필요해요.

lines.en: I have her bank details on my phone. Could you check if this is everything you need?
lines.ko: 어머니 은행 정보가 휴대폰에 있어요. 이거면 다 되는지 확인해 주시겠어요?
alt: Her bank information is on my phone. Is this everything you need?
I've got her account details here. Can you see if anything is missing?

lines.en: Sure. Yes, that's everything. The money should arrive in a day or two.
lines.ko: 네. 이거면 다 됐어요. 돈은 하루이틀이면 도착할 거예요.

expressions.note: 확실하지 않을 때 I think 를 붙임
recognize = 알아보다 · 내가 하지 않은 결제일 때

expressions.en: Is there any other way to ___?
expressions.note: 계획이 막혔을 때 대안을 물을 때
